verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions automations are YAML workflows (GitHub Actions-compatible) that live alongside code in Gitea repositories, so they inherit commit history (versioning) and Pull Request/AGit review with inline comments. Rolling back works by reverting commits through standard repository and branch management. missing for 10: explicit documentation that workflow files are stored and versioned in the repo, documented rollback/revert of automations, independent hands-on corroboration of a workflow-as-code review and rollback cycle.
